title: HB2654 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, adds a Class E felony offense for possession of a firearm if a person has previously been convicted of an offense for which the sentence was enhanced based upon certain factors. - Amends TCA Section 39-17-1307 and Title 40, Chapter 35, Part 1.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2018-02-01; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 1714903)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2018-02-01, as introduced. Adds a new subsection to 39-17-1307. Text printed with a hyphen break '§ 39- 11-106' (wrapped line). Senate twin SB 2219.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm, as defined in § 39- 11-106, and has been convicted of an offense and received an enhanced sentence pursuant to § 40-35-114(17).
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): (2) An offense under subdivision (1) is a Class E felony.
